title: Vrabel: I had 'difficult' talks over Russini photos

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Vrabel: I had 'difficult' talks over Russini photos
sources.description: Mike Vrabel said the Patriots and their fans will get "the best version of me going forward" after the New York Post published photos that appeared to show the coach embracing and holding hands with former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini.
